requiredBehaviors.behavior: prepare bootstrap state until a canonical target repository exists
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Bootstrap nach Grilling permits a project-memory-bootstrap until a confirmed target repository exists and then initializes or reuses the canonical memory structure.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: reuse an equivalent existing documentation structure rather than creating a parallel second brain
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Kanonischer Ablageort explicitly requires reuse of an equivalent existing project documentation structure and prohibits a parallel Second Brain.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: preserve pending external state and freshness instead of claiming completion
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Prerequisites, repository-state guidance and failure handling require pending external states to remain explicit until verified rather than being documented as completed.

requiredBehaviors.behavior: record the unavailable Drive write as pending and preserve the next action rather than fabricating a stored asset
requiredBehaviors.evidence: Drive Artifact Contract failure rules state that unavailable Drive writes are pending external states and require preserving the next action without claiming storage.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: create a second parallel project memory tree
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: The canonical storage contract explicitly prohibits a new parallel Project Memory tree where an equivalent structure already exists.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: mark pending CI delivery or Drive storage as complete
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Failure handling explicitly forbids documenting pending external states as completed, including unverified Drive writes.

forbiddenBehaviors.behavior: invent a Drive file link when upload or readback did not succeed
forbiddenBehaviors.evidence: Drive-Artifact Gate requires read-back verification and states that folder/file IDs and URLs must never be guessed.
